decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to combine the "Stiflenought" strategy with a combo approach. The deck focuses on playing powerful combo pieces such as Phyrexian Dreadnought and using Stifle to counter any attempts to remove them. It also incorporates card advantage and library manipulation with cards like Sylvan Library and Scroll Rack. The deck aims to control the game through counterspells like Foil and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, it includes card draw and tutoring effects to find and assemble the key combo pieces, as well as efficient land ramp with Land Tax and Mox Diamond.

The deck is built around utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures from the deck. It combines control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Duress with disruptive cards like Armageddon and Zur's Weirding to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes card draw through Sylvan Library and Scroll Rack, along with life gain from Ivory Tower. The main win conditions are through creatures like Shard Phoenix and Ancestor's Chosen, while also having options for graveyard hate with cards like Tormod's Crypt and Gaea's Blessing. The deck aims to control the game while setting up powerful creature plays through Oath of Druids.

The key focus of this deck is to aggressively play creatures like Nimble Mongoose, Werebear, and Terravore while disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Stone Rain and Wasteland. The deck aims to ramp up quickly with Mox Diamond and utilize land destruction effects to keep the opponent on the back foot. Devastating Dreams can be used as a board wipe if needed, while cards like Sylvan Library and Mulch help with card advantage and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and control the game through resource denial.

The main objective of this deck is to use the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought with Stifle to quickly get a 12/12 creature on the board while countering opponent's threats with Counterspells and Daze. The deck also includes cards like Meddling Mage and Vision Charm to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the game. The deck is designed to be proactive in setting up its combo while also having enough answers and protection to protect it and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The key concept of the deck is to use the synergy between cards like Hermit Druid, Squee, Goblin Nabob, and Survival of the Fittest to efficiently fill the graveyard and generate card advantage. This allows the player to easily activate Psychatog and use its ability to win the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Cabal Therapy and Mesmeric Fiend to disrupt the opponent's game plan and gain further advantage. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on using various control elements such as counterspells and disruptive creatures to slow down the opponent while building up powerful threats like Psychatog and Quirion Dryad. Winter Orb helps to further disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Gush and Opt provide card advantage and draw filtering. The mana base is streamlined to support the control strategy, with City of Brass and Flooded Strand providing access to the necessary colors. By controlling the game and gradually growing their threats, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counter spells, removal, and card advantage while using "Standstill" as a key card to slow down the opponent. It also aims to control the board with cards like "Wrath of God" and "Decree of Justice" while continuously disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like "Seal of Cleansing" and "Disenchant." The deck aims to slowly grind out value and win the game through incremental advantage and resource denial.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells (Mana Leak, Prohibit), removal spells (Disenchant, Swords to Plowshares), and board wipes (Wrath of God). The deck also utilizes card draw spells (Stroke of Genius, Impulse) to maintain card advantage and has a token generating card (Decree of Justice) as a win condition. The deck includes a few artifacts (Powder Keg, Masticore, Chromatic Sphere) for additional utility. The land base consists of Urza's Tron lands and basic lands for mana fixing.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of spellcasting, hand disruption, and creature removal to set up a powerful combo win condition. The deck includes cards like Grim Lavamancer, Hypnotic Specter, and Mesmeric Fiend to continuously put pressure on the opponent's hand and board. It also utilizes cards like Dark Ritual and Insidious Dreams to generate mana and search for key combo pieces. The win condition is achieved through casting Erratic Explosion, which allows the player to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent with Draco, while also utilizing cards like Blazing Specter and Cursed Scroll for additional damage.

The deck focuses on control through the use of Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures early in the game. It includes disruption spells like Duress and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to control the board. There are also cards for card advantage like Scroll Rack and Sylvan Library to stay ahead. The deck also includes some life gain and graveyard recursion to outlast the opponent. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to control the game while using Oath of Druids to quickly establish a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive, low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deplete their life total. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent through a combination of efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, alongside powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex also helps to ensure a continuous stream of damage, while also providing some additional reach to close out the game.

The deck aims to aggressively play creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Werebear to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. Terravore is a powerful threat that can grow as lands are sacrificed with cards like Weathered Wayfarer and Armageddon. The deck also utilizes Mox Diamond for ramp and efficient mana usage. It includes cards like Sylvan Safekeeper and Seal of Cleansing for protection and removal. The land destruction package with cards like Wasteland and Dust Bowl aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base while also utilizing lands like Treetop Village for additional threats.

This deck focuses on using efficient creatures, hand disruption, and removal spells to control the game. It aims to outvalue the opponent and grind them down with powerful threats like Ravenous Baloth and Deranged Hermit. The deck also has a graveyard recursion subtheme with cards like Recurring Nightmare and Volrath's Stronghold. Pernicious Deed acts as a sweeper while cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck excels at generating incremental advantage and stalling the game until it can take over with its powerful threats.
